meta.name: infographic-structure-creator
meta.description: Generate or update infographic Structure components for this repo (TypeScript/TSX in src/designs/structures). Use when asked to design, implement, or modify structure layouts (list/compare/sequence/hierarchy/relation/geo/chart), including layout logic, component composition, and registration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并生成信息图结构组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中创建或修改信息图布局组件
copy.tagline_en: Design and generate infographic structure components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or modify infographic layout components in a project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述，生成或更新信息图的结构组件代码（TypeScript/TSX 文件），包括布局逻辑、组件组合和注册。
howto.when: 当你要求设计、实现或修改信息图的结构布局（如列表、对比、序列、层级、关系、地理、图表）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个列表结构的信息图布局。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的结构组件代码。

say.text: 给这个对比布局加上添加/删除按钮。
say.note: Claude 会更新组件以支持动态增减。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate or update infographic structure component code (TypeScript/TSX) based on your request, including layout logic, component composition, and registration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design, implement, or modify structure layouts (list, compare, sequence, hierarchy, relation, geo, chart).

say_en.text: Create a list structure infographic layout.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding structure component code.

say_en.text: Add add/remove buttons to this compare layout.
say_en.note: Claude will update the component to support dynamic addition/removal.
